title: Agent Run Debugger Diagnosis v1
description: Observed facts about a log, ranked hypotheses with their alternatives and falsifiers, missing evidence and read-only next checks. 'observed' entries are facts about the imported evidence (provenance attached). 'hypotheses' are explanations. causal_findings is always empty in v1: a causal claim requires a controlled intervention.

kind.description: e.g. failure:tool_call, interrupted:event, contradiction:outcome_vs_events, anomaly:reported_usage, false_success:suspected, quarantine:contradictory_parents, empty:no_events

confidence.description: category derived from the stated evidence, never an uncalibrated number; a blocking evidence gap caps it at 'low'

correctness_claims.description: v1 mints no verdict on the work. A finished run is not a passed task.

causal_findings.description: empty by design: a causal finding requires a controlled intervention this build does not perform
